summary: CRT locale-string getter: returns locale info as a wide-character string, caching a detected system type in dword_8D4200 (1 = native GetLocaleInfoW, 2 = GetLocaleInfoA plus MultiByteToWideChar conversion). On the ANSI path it sizes and stack-allocates a buffer, queries it, converts to wide output (or returns the required size when cchData is 0), and returns 0 on every failure path.

operations.description: Branch on cached system type dword_8D4200; when unset, probe GetLocaleInfoW(0, 1, ...) then GetLocaleInfoA(0, 1, ...) to detect Unicode support (1 = wide, 2 = ANSI fallback), returning 0 if neither works. Called by sub_5968F6 (0x005968F6).
Cache the detected system type into dword_8D4200.
When the cached type is 1, return GetLocaleInfoW(Locale, LCType, lpLCData, cchData) directly.
Return 0 when the cached type is neither 1 nor 2.
Default the CodePage argument from the ::CodePage global (0x008D3F48) when the caller passed 0.
Size the ANSI buffer with a count-only GetLocaleInfoA(Locale, LCType, 0, 0) query; return 0 on failure.
Round the byte count up with (size + 3) & 0xFC and stack-allocate the buffer via alloca (__alloca_probe).
Fill the stack buffer via GetLocaleInfoA(Locale, LCType, buffer, size); return 0 on failure.
Convert the ANSI buffer to the wide output via MultiByteToWideChar(CodePage, 1, buffer, -1, lpLCData, cchData); query-only form when cchData is 0.
